title: ESTÁGIO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL - RIO DE JANEIRO/RJ
description:
A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, com o propósito de desenvolver projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. Desde então, temos atuado em diversos segmentos da economia brasileira, como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico e siderúrgico. Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau.
Com foco em inovação, a SANDECH adota tecnologias avançadas, como drones, laser scan, integração ao modelo BIM e óculos de realidade virtual, sempre buscando otimizar processos e elevar o nível de precisão e eficiência de seus projetos. Esse compromisso com a excelência também se reflete no Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, certificado internacionalmente pela ABS Quality Evaluations na norma ISO 9001:2015 e aprovado em auditorias realizadas por cinco de seus principais clientes. Com um SGQ maduro e bem estruturado, estamos habilitados a executar projetos de engenharia considerados críticos.
Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira.
RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoiar a equipe de engenharia na elaboração e atualização de projetos;
  • Auxiliar na compatibilização de disciplinas e revisão de documentos técnicos;
  • Contribuir com levantamentos e organização de informações de projeto;
  • Apoiar na interface com demais áreas técnicas;
  • Participar de reuniões internas e contribuir com o andamento das demandas do setor;
  • Cumprir prazos e manter a organização dos arquivos e entregas sob sua responsabilidade.
FORMAÇÃO
  • Curso: Engenharia Civil
  • Período: a partir do 5º período
REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS:
  • Ter cursado disciplinas relacionadas a projetos ou desenho técnico
  • Inglês Intermediário
FERRAMENTAS DESEJÁVEIS:
  • AutoCAD, Revit ou ferramentas similares
  • CYPE ou outros softwares de dimensionamento
  • Excel e Pacote Office

SOBRE NÓS!
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí!
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 14 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar!

title: MEDICO CIRURGIAO GERAL EMERGENCIA - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Desde dezembro de 2024, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade e é uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário), tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

As responsabilidades incluem prestar atendimento aos pacientes de acordo com a demanda, efetuando a história clínica, exame físico, hipótese diagnóstica, encaminhamento a exames complementares quando necessário e realização de procedimentos cirúrgicos indicados, sempre zelando pela conduta ética profissional.

Requisitos mínimos:

  1. Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  2. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Cirurgia Geral
  3. Experiência de 6 meses na função
  4. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 12h semanais

Horário: 19:00 - 07:00 ou 07:00 - 19:00

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviços, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em outras modalidades contratuais, devem observar as normativas de RH vigentes, consultando o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Sobre a SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina

A SPDM é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de caráter filantrópico, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

Seu foco principal é a inserção no sistema de saúde para tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em todos os níveis, com forte vínculo com a comunidade e compromisso social de atender a todos sem discriminação.

A instituição vem expandindo suas áreas de atuação, incluindo projetos na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande organização filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

A SPDM contribui para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do Sistema Único de Saúde, promovendo acesso universal com atendimento de alta qualidade por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, sempre buscando melhorar os indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida da população, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência, recrutando periodicamente esses profissionais através de anúncios em jornais locais.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis da assistência às populações dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: ESPECIALISTA DE RH (REMUNERAÇÃO)
description:
Job description

Somos o Grupo Energisa!

Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro.

Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás.

Transformamos, através de nossos mais de 17.000 colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos!

Quer fazer parte desta história? Confere se esta oportunidade tem match com o seu perfil e vem conosco participar desta jornada de seleção!


Main responsibilities

  • Ser referência técnica e responsável pela gestão dos assuntos relacionados a Remuneração Fixa na organização;
  • Responsável por aprimorar as práticas de Remuneração, produzindo inovações na área, alinhado as melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Desenvolver soluções relacionados a Remuneração Fixa, com foco em otimização de processos, uso de novas tecnologias e desenvolvimento de pessoal;
  • Elaborar e participar de pesquisas sobre as tendências de mercado na área de remuneração, visando subsidiar a análise da competitividade externa e a definição das políticas de remuneração da empresa;
  • Realizar análises de cargos, conforme metodologia de pontos Korn Ferry (Hay Group);
  • Elaborar tabelas salariais, com base na política definida pela empresa, visando a facilitar a administração de cargos e salários;
  • Elaborar análises e estudos relacionados com a estrutura de cargos, visando fornecer subsídios para as políticas de planejamento de sucessões e desenvolvimento de pessoal;
  • Realizar a análise e desenvolvimento de políticas e práticas de remuneração de participações e aquisições;
  • Subsidiar a análise dos casos de alterações de cargos, promoções, transferências e outros tipos de movimentação de pessoal;
  • Apoio na definição de premissas orçamentárias de Remuneração Fixa;
  • Elaborar relatórios e análises em dashboard nos temas de Remuneração Fixa.

Requirements and skills

O que é necessário você apresentar:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Pensamento lógico estruturado;
  • Capacidade de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência na metodologia Korn Ferry;
  • Excel Avançado;
  • Conhecimentos em Power BI, SharePoint e Power Automate.

O que será considerado como diferencial:

  • Pós graduação;
  • Experiência em empresas nacionais de capital aberto;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;

Job description

A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos, e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, consolidando a Radix como uma empresa global.

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

#VemPraRadix



Main responsibilities

Buscamos pessoas que queiram somar e fazer parte de um ecossistema que leva inovação, tecnologia e soluções para diversos segmentos do mercado. Aqui, os desafios são constantes e você não vai cair na rotina.

Como Profissional de Engenharia Mecânica, você irá:

  • Identificar, revisar e consolidar o escopo de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e modificações mecânicas.
  • Coordenar intervenções em equipamentos rotativos (bombas, compressores, turbinas) e estáticos (vasos de pressão, trocadores de calor, tanques, tubulações).
  • Avaliar desenhos, isométricos, P&IDs e especificações técnicas.
  • Participar da análise e seleção de materiais, procedimentos de manutenção e inspeção.
  • Supervisionar a desmontagem, inspeção, substituição e montagem de equipamentos.
  • Garantir aderência aos procedimentos, normas técnicas e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar atividades de inspeção e testes (ex.: END, testes hidrostáticos) para equipamentos.
  • Integrar resultados de inspeção à estratégia de manutenção e integridade.
  • Atualizar a documentação técnica das intervenções de campo.
  • Gerar relatórios técnicos diversos: causas-raiz, integridade, recomendações, planos de ação, atas, etc.

Requirements and skills

Para essa vaga, você deve ter:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em equipamentos diversos da indústria offshore, topside e praça de máquinas.
  • Experiência em paradas programadas offshore.
  • Conhecimento em normas aplicáveis (API 510, 570, 650, 686; ASME; NR-13, NR-10, NR-33, NR-35).
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão Primavera P6, MS Project, e sistemas de controle de escopo e produtividade.
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de CMMS (SAP, AMOS, STAR).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de ativos.

Detalhes da vaga:

  • Modelo de trabalho: CLT
  • Regime de contratação: Híbrido, com possibilidade de embarques nas unidades dos clientes atendidos pela Radix.

Additional information

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde + Odontológico
  • Médico da empresa
  • Gympass (+3 dependentes)
  • Auxílio creche até 3 anos
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas
  • Auxílio home office
  • VR e/ou VA
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Universidade Corporativa
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma
  • Programa de treinamentos internos
  • Plano de Incentivos atrelado à avaliação de Desempenho.

A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque:

  • Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores.
  • O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção.
  • Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão.
  • Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e, na maioria dos projetos, é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.

title: Product Manager
description:

, a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a highly inquisitive and driven Product Manager to enhancethe experience of our SaaS platform and deliver impactful solutions to our customers.

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.

As a Product Manager at XILO, you’ll be at the center of driving product improvements that directly impact our customers’ experience and businessoutcomes. You’ll collaborate with customers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to prioritize and implement new features, fix bugs, and enhance existingproducts. This role is perfect for a highly curious and tech-savvy individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about deliveringintuitive, self-service solutions that drive adoption and growth.
Key Responsibilities
Schedule and conduct 3 customer interviews weekly to gather actionablefeedback.
Plan and document 2 sprints of development ahead of Engineers, usingstandard prioritization processes.
Create product requirement documents for all assigned new features.
Work with design to design out each planned release phase (MVP, beta,full release)
Build data pipelines to measure customer adoption across multipleproducts accurately.
Enhance all current products to make them more intuitive and self-servicing.
Drive increased customer adoption across all products.
Improve sales pilot success rates to 80% by delivering exceptionalproduct experiences.
What we’re looking for
Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for uncovering insightsthrough customer feedback.
Tech-savvy and comfortable learning complex systems quickly.
Process-driven thinker who sees everything as an opportunity tostreamline and improve.
Proven ability to conduct multiple customer interviews and synthesizefindings.
Quick learner who can master the industry and product at a fast pace.
Basic understanding of Engineering concepts to collaborate effectivelywith technical teams.
Works hard (10+ hours daily when needed) and embraces the challengesof a startup environment.
No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and improvement.
Relentless work ethic: doesn’t stop until the job is done and done right.
Builds genuine relationships with customers and teammates.
Positive, motivating, and supportive presence within the team.
Accountable for successes and failures, fostering a culture of ownership.
Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coachmentality).
Passionate about AI and its transformative potential.

Familiar with JIRA, Agile/Scrum practices, PRD writing, and working with design and analytics tools.
What we offer
Collaborative and innovative work environment.
Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health and wellness package.
Budget for English lessons.
Why Join XILO?
Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Manager at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to directly shape the evolution of our platform, improve customer experiences, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.
At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

title: Senior Full-Stack Web Software Engineer (Remote)
description:
Unilingo connects a single video to every audience, in every language, on every major platform — with no extra work. This is not some ‘one-click’ marketing fluff. With Unilingo, one upload is all it takes. We pioneered multi-language content for YouTube, putting MrBeast and other top creators into 10+ languages. Since then, we've given creators 100 billion views, $50 million in AdSense revenue, and global recognition. With 48,000+ global submissions in the pipeline, we're only getting started. We’re building the command center for digital content — a syndication network that publishes from a single upload to any platform, in any format, in any language.
What you build here will be seen in every country on Earth.
Please email your resume to:

The Role
We’re a growing team of self-motivated engineers. We put in long hours not because we have to but because we care about the impact we’re generating. We hope to do more in a week than most other teams do in a month.
We are looking for a full-stack engineer who’s excited to experience the adventure of being in an early stage startup. We hope for your time here to be the most rewarding in your career. You’ll be given a lot of responsibility and the freedom to solve problems.
Responsibilities
Own the problem and work with the engineers and designer to generate a solution
Build, test, and ship features that solves user problems
Look at data and talk to users to get feedback about the feature
Triage and fix bugs
Generate proposals (through meetings, docs, and Figma) to help align team on your solution if it’s a multi-person effort
Review PRs to ensure that you’re not siloed in your own feature and that standards are upheld
Requirements
5+ years of experience with Node, React, and Typescript
You’re not afraid to touch all parts of code when needed — from mouse click to DB. If you specialize in back-end, you should at least be able to disable a button on the front-end. If you’re front-end, you should at least be able to cast a return type of an endpoint field from a string to an int
Deploy your own code. We don’t have an ops team here, so you get to own deployment as well
Excellent written skills (in English)
B2 or above spoken English proficiency
Bonus
Previous startup experience — having started your own or joined one before
Python and some experience with implementing or deploying ML models
Speaks a language other than English (and code)
Cloud functions, NoSQL DB
Why Work With Us
You’ll hopefully experience the highest growth rate of your career here. You’ll be given freedom to execute. You and the rest of the team will likely make mistakes, but that’s okay because it’s a signal that we’re going to the edge of our capabilities - which means growth. We believe that this is what a startup is all about.
You will be working closely with Jon, our CTO, and Farbod, our CEO. Jon is an ex-Meta engineer and a top creator himself in his past life with 20M+ views across YouTube and TikTok. Farbod is a serial entrepreneur with one exit and is obsessed about distributing the highest quality content for their users. He’s spent months living with creators (literally) to understand their workflows, pain points, and what they need next.
Values
Mission over team over self : We value distributing content to our customers globally, working hard, and having fun with our team — without ego. Everyone at the company contributes to the final product.
We constantly question the status quo : We don’t copy what’s been done before. We ask, “What would this look like if we started from scratch?” and we’re not afraid to break norms to do things better.
Work hard and smart : We put in long hours, but only on the highest-value tasks. Our goal is to grow the company — and for everyone here to grow with it.
We move at the speed of light to delight our users : Our ideal sprint is three to four days. Our ideal shipping cadence is daily.
Artifacts are greater than talking : We communicate through action. That means documents, Figma files, Slack updates, commits, PRs — whatever it takes to keep work flowing asynchronously.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Floorplan-to-3D Automation)
description:
About Formify
Formify
is building the future of digital manufacturing for interior spaces --- from online 3D configuration to ready-to-machine outputs for kitchens, closets, and bathrooms. As part of our roadmap, we're developing AI tools that convert floorplans into 3D layouts to accelerate design, quoting, and production workflows.
Your Role
We're seeking an AI/ML Engineer to lead the development of a system that can
analyze floorplan images (PDFs, DWGs, etc.) and convert them into 3D geometry
--- walls, doors, windows, and more --- ready for our CPQ engine. You'll develop core AI capabilities and work closely with our design automation and backend teams to bring intelligent layout recognition to life.
What You'll Do
Design and train deep learning models to extract spatial and semantic information from 2D floorplans (images or vector files).
Develop pipelines to convert detected geometry into structured 3D models (e.g., wall objects, door/window placement).
Work with vector data (DXF/DWG), PDFs, or raster images to detect key architectural features.
Collaborate with CAD and backend engineers to translate AI output into parametric geometry.
Optimize models for speed, accuracy, and usability in real-world production environments.
Create optimal cabinetry layouts and suggestions from data provided from designers.
Experience Levels
Mid-Level (3-6 years experience)
Strong experience with
deep learning frameworks
(PyTorch, TensorFlow) and
vision models
(YOLO, UNet, Detectron, etc.)
Experience in
computer vision
or
document/image parsing
Understanding of
geometry-based learning
and spatial context
Ability to translate model output into geometric representations
Senior Level (6+ years experience)
Advanced expertise in
geometry-based learning ,
OCR with spatial context , and complex vision systems
Proven ability to lead ML projects from conception to production
Experience with CAD/BIM environments, Rhino/Grasshopper, or geometry processing libraries (e.g., trimesh, Open3D)
Track record of deploying ML models in real-world manufacturing or design environments
Project leadership and team mentoring experience
Bonus Experience
Experience with CAD/BIM environments, Rhino/Grasshopper, or geometry processing libraries
Knowledge of architectural drawing standards and conventions
Experience in manufacturing or design automation industries
Why You'll Love This
You'll work at the bleeding edge of vision + design automation.
Your work will drastically reduce the time from inspiration to production in the interiors industry.
Join a cross-functional team where AI connects directly to real-world manufacturing.
Competitive compensation with opportunity to pioneer AI applications in manufacturing.

title: Sr. SAP Fieldglass Developer
description:
Title: Sr. SAP Fieldglass Developer
Location: Remote, candidates based out of Brazil
Duration: 6 month CLT contract with potential to extend
Pay Range: $20-30k BRL per month
Must Haves:
5+ years of experience in SAP development, with at least 4 years in SAP Fieldglass (SOW, CW, integrations).
Proven experience in Fieldglass-SAP S/4HANA integration, including CPI and API-based approaches.
Strong understanding of Fieldglass data models, configuration, and extensibility.
Experience with facility access systems integration is a strong plus.
Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAP Business Network, and clean core principles.
Ability to conduct technical assessments, identify gaps, and propose remediation strategies.
English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.
Proven experience implementing Fieldglass integrations
Strong understanding of SAP best practices, architecture principles, and integration strategies.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience in Agile methodology usage would be differential.
SAP certifications would be considered differential.
Day to Day:
A Senior SAP Fieldglass Developer is required to lead the technical assessment, enhancement, and implementation of strategic initiatives across the SAP Fieldglass platform. This role focuses on optimizing contingent workforce management, improving integration reliability, and enabling advanced capabilities such as assignment management and facility access integration. The developer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, compliant, and clean core-aligned solutions.
Assess and implement Fieldglass Assignment Management to streamline the integration between maintenance work orders and contingent labor.
Ensure accurate data flow and process alignment between Fieldglass and SAP S/4HANA.
Stabilize and enhance integrations between Fieldglass and S/4HANA for SOWs, timesheets, and fee submissions.
Troubleshoot and resolve interface issues, ensuring data consistency and performance.
Design and implement integration between Fieldglass and global facility access systems (e.g., Genetec, Alert Enterprise).
Enable validation of contractor time-on-site against timesheet data for compliance and cost control.
Improve usability and performance of Fieldglass through configuration enhancements and process automation.
Support training and documentation efforts to ensure adoption of optimized workflows.
Support the phased rollout of Fieldglass SOW functionality across Brazil and other South American regions.
Ensure localization, compliance, and alignment with global standards.
Lead technical efforts in expanding Fieldglass CW capabilities across regions (e.g., NAM, SAM, APAC).
Ensure scalable architecture and integration with SAP and third-party systems.
Ensure adherence to SAP Clean Core principles, minimizing custom code and promoting extensibility through SAP BTP and side-by-side extensions.
Advocate for standardized processes and modular architecture to maintain system integrity and simplify upgrades.
Design solutions that leverage SAP-recommended extensibility options such as In-App Extensibility, Key User Tools, and SAP BTP services.
Evaluate and refactor legacy customizations to align with clean core strategies.
Promote decoupled integration using APIs and event-driven architectures to reduce system dependencies.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure custom developments are compliant with SAP’s clean core guidelines.
Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.
Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Sales Director, LATAM
description:
Wenham Carter is proud to be supporting a European software innovator that’s transforming how energy companies across the globe manage their most critical infrastructure.
Our client is a specialist provider of enterprise-grade software built specifically for the electric utility sector. Headquartered in Germany and operating internationally, their suite of products spans Asset Performance Management (APM), Protection & IED, Network Model Management, and Outage Management Systems - empowering utilities to operate with greater insight, safety, and efficiency.
With many of the world’s most advanced grid operators already relying on their technology, the business is now scaling its presence in Latin America. As such, we’re hiring a
Sales Director, LATAM – Energy Markets , to take ownership of the company’s commercial success across the region.
The Opportunity
This is a senior-level, high-impact role for a commercially driven leader with deep roots in the LATAM energy sector. You will spearhead all sales efforts across key territories, particularly
Brazil, Chile, and Colombia
- working directly with utilities, system operators, and regulatory stakeholders to bring best-in-class solutions to mission-critical environments.
You'll be responsible for shaping the regional go-to-market strategy, managing end-to-end enterprise sales cycles, and building high-value, long-term relationships with commercial and technical decision-makers.
What You’ll Do
Drive new business
across LATAM, identifying and converting opportunities within utilities, grid operators, ISOs, and energy companies
Lead strategic enterprise sales cycles , owning deals from initial contact through to close
Develop and execute regional strategy , working closely with the global sales and marketing leadership
Engage deeply with client stakeholders , including executive and operational teams, to foster trust and partnership
Represent the business
at major industry conferences, roundtables, and sector events across Latin America
Partner cross-functionally
with global product, pre-sales, and technical teams to ensure alignment and success
Your Background
We’re looking for a seasoned commercial operator with a strong command of LATAM’s energy markets and a deep understanding of how complex software solutions are sold in industrial environments.
The ideal candidate will bring:
7+ years of enterprise software sales experience (APM, EAM, OT or similar solutions)
A proven track record in the
LATAM utility and energy landscape , especially in
Brazil, Chile, and Colombia
Strong relationships with
grid operators, utilities, and energy stakeholders
in the region
Experience managing
complex, multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales
Fluent Spanish and English
required;
Portuguese
highly advantageous
Gravitas, consultative sales ability, and the resilience to work across both public and private energy institutions
Willingness to travel extensively across Latin America as needed
Why Now?
This is not just another sales role. It’s an opportunity to lead regional expansion for a fast-growing software vendor that’s doubling in size and already trusted by some of the most sophisticated electric utilities worldwide.
You’ll be joining at a time of significant growth, with the autonomy to shape market strategy, influence product direction, and drive measurable impact in an industry undergoing massive digital transformation.
If you're a commercial leader with a passion for the energy sector and a desire to build something meaningful in LATAM, let’s talk.

Remote, Brazil

Solid grounding in functional, regression, and integration testing methodologies.

Hands-on with Selenium, Cypress, Postman/Newman, or equivalent frameworks.

Confident validating request/response payloads, headers, auth flows, and error handling.

Comfortable creating clear, actionable Jira tickets that engineers love (and fear).

Understand how QA fits into DevOps; you wire tests into CI and keep the build clean.

Bash/Python/TypeScript chops for crafting helpers, stubs, or data generators.

Experience using LLMs or AI tools to auto-generate test cases, data, or scripts.

Competitive salary + stock options.

title: Médico Neurologista
description:
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA/RESIDENTE NA TELADOC HEALTH"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos
Neurologista,
que esteja cursando Residência, ou Especialização, ou que já tenha concluído a formação. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
*
A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!
O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades: Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em Neurologia, ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Neurologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios neurológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Neurologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais neurológicos através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças neurológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Neurologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
FORMAÇÃO ACADEMICA (será solicitado comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM NEUROLOGIA CONCLUIDAS, OU EM ANDAMENTO
CERTIFICAÇÕES (será solicitada comprovação durante o processo seletivo):
Formação Acadêmica (será submetido a comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PSIQUIATRIA, COMPLETO, OU EM ANDAMENTO
Certificações (serão solicitadas no processo seletivo, como carater eliminatório):
Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Neurologia, modelo oficial (Certidão de RQE/Certificado de Registro de Especialidade, pelo CRM responsável);
Matrícula do último semestre, em Instituição de Ensino aprovada, em Especialização, Residência, ou Pós-Graduação;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).
CONTRATO: PJ - (necessário ter CNPJ)
HORÁRIO: A COMBINAR
REMUNERAÇÃO: SERÁ ALINHADA NO PROCESSO SELETIVO

title: Lead AI Success & Solutions
description:
About the Company
RapidCanvas is the trusted partner for transforming your business with AI. We offer the only hybrid enterprise AI platform that combines autonomous agents with human experts to make enterprise-grade AI accessible to all organizations—without the massive investment or deep technical expertise it used to take. Our unique approach delivers measurable business outcomes 10X faster at 80% lower cost, helping global leaders in manufacturing, retail and consumer goods, financial services, and infrastructure turn what was once impossible into practical, everyday reality.
About the Role
RapidCanvas is hiring customer-facing specialists focusing on
AI Success & Solutions
to lead end-to-end delivery of bespoke AI projects—from initial solution design through full customer success ownership. This role merges the depth of a Solutions Architect with the accountability of a Customer Success leader. You will work across pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring our clients see real business value from our AI capabilities. The hiring seniority level will depend on the candidate’s depth of experience across customer-facing solution delivery, ability to drive measurable business impact, and demonstrated ownership in ambiguous or fast-paced environments.

Pre-Sale: Discovery & Solutioning
Partner with Sales and Data Science to deeply understand the customer’s business context and challenges.
Define clear problem statements, document current state processes, and align on success criteria and KPIs.
Design solution architecture and data flow diagrams tailored to each use case.
Assess data feasibility and AI-fit for the proposed use case.
Set up technical and collaboration workspaces (Slack, Drive, JIRA, etc.) with naming and access discipline.
Post-Sale: Execution & Success

Manage the execution and implementation of the solution, ensuring clarity of scope, timeline, and handoffs.
Lead all internal and customer-facing check-ins, with clear agendas, follow-ups, and next-step ownership.
Facilitate UAT and deployment, ensuring measurable outcomes are validated.
Track and report on success metrics across 30/60/90-day milestones and ensure platform adoption.
Operational Excellence
Maintain rigorous documentation: dataset inventories, architectural diagrams, solution design docs, etc.
Ensure consistent file naming, visual branding, and version control across all customer-facing material.
Keep Slack, HubSpot, JIRA, and Confluence spaces current and synchronized.
Proactively escalate blockers, risks, or unclear ownership to leadership with proposed resolutions.
Strategic Growth
Identify expansion opportunities based on solution usage and customer success metrics.
Collaborate with Product to feed back client needs and usage patterns into roadmap priorities.
Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the client, helping them envision and prioritize future AI investments.
Qualifications
At least six (6) years in a hybrid technical+customer-facing role (Solutions Architect, Customer Success, Engagement Manager, etc.).
Strong understanding of applied Data Science, ML, GenAI (e.g., LLM Prompting, RAG).
Demonstrated success delivering AI or data-driven solutions in a consulting or startup setting.
Excellent storytelling and business value articulation skills for both technical and executive audiences.
Detail-oriented with exceptional project management and follow-through.
Global client experience is strongly preferred.
Prior experience in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with high expectations for ownership and delivery.
Professional fluency in English is required.
Why Join Us
Drive measurable impact for Fortune 500 customers across the globe, helping them turn AI vision into operational value. Be part of a category-defining AI company, pioneering a hybrid model that bridges agents and experts. Own strategic accounts end-to-end and shape what modern AI success looks like. Work with a cross-functional, high-performance team that values execution, clarity, and outcomes. Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market. Recognized as a Top 5 Data Science and Machine Learning platform on G2 for customer satisfaction.

Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market.

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Product Manager
description:
A Risposta é a maior plataforma de satisfação e inteligência de clientes para restaurantes no Brasil, presente em mais de 1.500 casas — de grupos como Outback, Aizomê, Moma, Rascal, Origem, entre muitos outros. Usamos tecnologia e dados para ajudar restaurantes a oferecerem experiências melhores e mais humanas, todos os dias.
Estamos procurando uma ou um Product Manager para liderar iniciativas estratégicas que impactam diretamente como restaurantes operam, se conectam com seus clientes e tomam decisões de negócio.
Sobre a vaga
Você será responsável por transformar dores reais dos nossos clientes em soluções digitais inteligentes, escaláveis e centradas no usuário. Irá atuar junto aos times de engenharia, design, dados e atendimento em um ambiente ágil, dinâmico e com autonomia para experimentar.
Responsabilidades
Liderar o ciclo de vida completo de features e produtos, da concepção ao pós-lançamento.
Coletar e priorizar demandas com base em dados, feedbacks e alinhamento estratégico.
Criar documentos de produto claros (roadmaps, epics, user stories, critérios de aceitação).
Colaborar com desenvolvedores e designers para entregar experiências de ponta.
Acompanhar métricas de adoção, uso, NPS e satisfação.
Contribuir com a visão de produto e com a evolução do stack de soluções da Risposta.
Requisitos
Experiência anterior como PM em produtos digitais (SaaS, B2B ou B2C).
Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados.
Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
Experiência com métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas como Jira, Figma, Notion.
Familiaridade com o setor de foodservice ou hospitalidade é um diferencial.
O que oferecemos
Ambiente de empresa sólida e em crescimento rápido.
Desafios reais com impacto no dia a dia de milhares de restaurantes e milhões de clientes.
Time colaborativo, com liberdade para propor e testar ideias.
Flexibilidade, transparência e foco em resultado.
Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, em um produto com escala nacional, ajudando restaurantes a oferecerem experiências memoráveis, vem conversar com a gente.

title: Scrum Master
description:

5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master

A Fortune 100 client is needing a Scrum Master to join their enterprise Data Management Operations team. You will be responsible for 2 pods of Data Engineers and Data Modelers. The team that you would be joining is focused on ensuring on-time delivery for data products within subset organizations. description:

title: IT Service Level Manager
description:
BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better TomorrowTM by Building a Smokeless World.
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!
British American Tobacco Brazil has an exciting opportunity for an IT Service Level Manager in Rio de Janeiro
The Service Level Manager (SLM) is responsible for ensuring that all IT services meet the agreed-upon service levels and performance standards. This role involves managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring service performance, and working closely with both internal teams and external vendors to ensure high-quality service delivery. The SLM will play a crucial role in aligning IT services with business objectives and customer expectations.
The position requires strong alignment with ITIL best practices, COBIT governance principles, and industry performance benchmarks. The SLM is also a key agent in driving continuous improvement, digital transformation, and the innovation of user-centric services.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Develop, negotiate, and manage SLAs with internal and external stakeholders and monitor and report on service performance against SLAs.
Conduct regular reviews of SLAs to ensure they remain relevant and aligned with business needs.
Maintain a centralized and accessible Service Catalogue and being responsible for ITSM governance, for example, incident, change, problem and transition management.
Use data-driven insights to predict and prevent potential service disruptions and analyze service performance and structured root cause analysis data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Manage capacity and delivery plan (internal and external teams)
Act as the primary point of contact for all service-related issues and escalations and communicate service performance and improvement plans to stakeholders.
Lead initiatives to improve service delivery processes and enhance customer satisfaction and promote user-centric innovation and stay updated with industry best practices and emerging trends in IT service management.
This position needs to manage all the running cost of IT, always looking for saving opportunities, cost avoidance and other ways to bring efficiency. Also responsible for IT Services project budget.
What are we looking for?
Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT service management or a related role.
Proven track record of managing SLAs and improving service delivery in a large organization and demonstrated success in managing SLAs, dashboards, vendor relationships, and governance reporting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholders.
Advanced English verbal and written; Spanish it ́s a nice to have.
Experience Level Management (XLA) skills to enhance user experience levels and ensure smooth operations and strategic mindset with focus on innovation, agility, and experience management.
What we offer you?

  • We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
  • Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
  • Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
  • You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
  • We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes

WHY JOIN BAT?
We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.
Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

Para que isso aconteça precisamos ser ágeis, pois as coisas aqui acontecem em uma velocidade acima da média. No nosso dia-dia, aprendemos muito e muito rápido, em um ambiente leve, divertido e desafiador.

#ouseetransforme e #sejaTOTVER
Missão do cargo:
Acreditamos que o SUCESSO do cliente é o nosso SUCESSO! E para isso, estamos à procura de pessoas inquietas, fanáticas por resultados e amantes de tecnologia. Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, trabalho em equipe e gosta de fazer acontecer esta vaga será sua! Venha trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza gente boa que é boa gente. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

Resolver problemas técnicos de complexidade moderada;
Colaborar com o gerenciamento do produto e outras partes interessadas (Frontend, UX etc.) a fim de manter um ambiente iterativo e acelerado;
Reconhecer impedimentos à nossa eficiência como equipe ("dívida técnica"), propondo e implementando soluções;
Entregar com segurança melhorias com orientação mínima de outros membros da equipe. Colaborar com a equipe em projetos maiores;
Fornecer orientação para engenheiros iniciantes e intermediários de sua equipe para ajudá-los a crescer em suas responsabilidades técnicas.
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:
Área de formação acadêmica: Relacionada a área de desenvolvimento de software.

Experiência em C#;
Experiência com RabbitMQ;
Conhecimento em Entity Framework;
Conhecimento em Angular;
Desejável conhecimentos em CQRS e Docker;
Experiência com problemas de desempenho e otimização, particularmente em larga escala, e uma capacidade demonstrada para diagnosticar e prevenir esses problemas;

Mentalidade positiva e orientada para a solução;
Auto motivado, autodidata e auto gerenciado, com fortes habilidades organizacionais;
Desejo de trabalhar em colaboração com outras partes da organização.
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.
A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.
E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.
Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.
Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

title: Head of Engineering
description:
CTO/Head of Engineering (Remote)
Are you someone who wants to empower and inspire others? Do you find yourself looking for opportunities for continuous learning and improvement? Are you driven by the satisfaction of completing tasks and achieving goals?
Are you seeking a mission-driven culture that fosters your professional growth? If so, we would love to connect with you!
Who We Are:
We are a remote team that improves online medical education and teaches healthcare professionals domestically and abroad how to save lives. We also take the same advanced life-saving training we developed for medical professionals and give it to underserved populations all around the world at no cost. We work in conjunction with the Disque Foundation to fulfill its mission of advancing healthcare education to the underserved through advanced technology
.
Check out our
website
:
Mission
is to provide free advanced healthcare education to underserved populations in the US and around the world.
Our Goal
is to empower 10 million people by 2025.
Our Values:
Dedication to “CANI” culture:
Constant and Never-Ending Improvement mentality.
Positive Focus/Resourceful/Gritty/Perseverance:
A self-starter who isn’t held back by a lack of direction or detailed instruction.
Impeccable Ball Handling Skills:
Responsibility, Accountability, Ownership.
Unwavering Integrity:
We Always do the Right Thing.
Who we’re looking for:
We seek an executive-level technology leader who is
visionary, strategic, and passionate about innovation
- without needing to be hands-on in coding. As a
CTO/Head of Engineering
, you will guide our tech and product strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and fostering a culture of growth and servant leadership. This is a
hybrid role
combining strategic leadership with hands-on involvement. Approximately 25–30% of the time will be dedicated to implementation and debugging, while the remaining focus will be on system architecture, technical direction, and guiding internal teams.
Work directly with external vendors and partners to align on expectations and drive outcomes—this role does not involve formal vendor management but requires effective collaboration to ensure delivery meets our standards.
Why this role is unique:
We are
transitioning from in-house backend development to a third-party tech provider
to enhance scalability, security, and performance while reducing bugs and maintenance overhead. This is a
strategic shift
that allows us to focus on front-end improvements, marketing experiments, and product innovation. We need a leader excited about this transformation - someone who can refine product strategy, guide teams, and drive innovation rather than push for in-house backend development.
As a CTO/Head of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Technology & Product Strategy
– Define and execute a long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals and innovation.
Leadership & Growth
– Inspire, mentor, and empower teams to drive effective execution.
Product Ownership & Execution
– Oversee product evolution, ensuring front-end and API development supports user experience, marketing agility, and growth initiatives.
Security & Scalability
– Ensure site security, performance, and scalability by working with our third-party technology partner while keeping internal processes efficient.
Technical Escalation & Support
– Provide backup for critical issues and guide troubleshooting, ensuring smooth collaboration with third-party providers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
– Collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations to leverage technology for business impact.
Vendor & Partner Management
– Manage relationships with external tech providers to maximize efficiency, reliability, and innovation.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are:
A visionary and servant leader who inspires teams and drives strategy.
Product-driven with business acumen, focusing on strategic impact rather than just technical execution.
Excited about transitioning to a third-party provider, focusing on innovation, scalability, and growth.
Technical but not hands-on daily, guiding decisions without coding every day.
Adaptable, proactive, and resourceful in navigating complex challenges.
A tech enthusiast passionate about AI and emerging technologies.
A strong communicator who can explain complex concepts to non-experts.
Remote-ready and thrive in a flexible, independent work environment.
Must-Have Experience
Leadership experience in a technology or product-focused executive role
Experience with Client side web development (HTML/CSS/JS/Smarty/Smarty Twig)
Deep understanding of front-end and API-driven development (modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, AngularJS), CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, Foundation, UI Kit), component-based architecture, GraphQL)
Understanding of AWS, CDN, MariaDB, Apache HTTPd web servers, Linux, Cloud computing, CI/CD, cybersecurity
Experience working with Platform as a Service (PaaS) and API-driven environments
Security and scalability expertise in a digital product environment
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage external technology vendors
Experience collaborating with external vendors to drive outcomes without direct management responsibility.
Nice to Have (or willingness to learn)
Cloudflare (maintenance, security, performance optimization)
WordPress, PHP, MySQL
GTM, on-site data tracking, SEO
Experience with automation tools, AI-driven tech, and experimentation platforms (e.g., VWO)
UX/UI familiarity (Figma, Adobe XD)
What This Role is NOT
A hands-on backend developer role.
A position for someone looking to rebuild everything in-house.
A rigid environment - our culture values adaptability, collaboration, and strategic thinking.
Additional Information:
This role is full-time, requiring 35-40 hours per week.
It is a fully remote contract position, with Independent Contractors responsible for their taxes and benefits.
Each applicant is required to successfully complete a paid Trial Period before transitioning to this role.
If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications but believe you will be a great fit, you should still seriously consider applying.
Ready to apply?
If you share our values and enthusiasm for empowering the world, please send a resume and a short cover letter with a brief description of where you see yourself adding value to the team to
.
Please address your cover letter to Helen.
SaveaLife.com does not discriminate based on sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, race, ethnicity, age, religion, or economic background. Further, we strongly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented identities to apply, including identities not explicitly named above. If there are any considerations or qualifications not acknowledged in our job description that you feel are important and relevant to this position, we encourage you to bring them to light in your application.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

title: Traffic Analyst
description:
Position: Traffic Analyst / Analista de OPEC

Area: Programaçao e OPEC

Entity: Nosso Futebol - Sporty Group

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - On-site

About Nosso Futebol:

Nosso Futebol, part of Sporty Group, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We have distribution agreements with leading local Pay TV operators and a growing digital presence. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.

Role Overview:

As a Traffic Analyst at Nosso Futebol, you will be responsible for ensuring the proper scheduling and execution of the channel’s programming and commercial breaks. This role requires precision, coordination, and strong communication across content, operations, and commercial teams to ensure daily broadcast accuracy and efficiency.

Responsibilities:

EN

  • Responsible for reviewing, organizing, and inputting commercial breaks into the playout system.
  • Ensures the correct scheduling of content, promos, and commercials, in accordance with the specifications established in the programming instructions (PIs).
  • Controls all materials scheduled for broadcast, checking their availability, technical quality, and correct naming.
  • Ensures the receipt of CRTs and/or other necessary documentation.
  • Performs last-minute operational adjustments as requested by the Programming Coordination team.
  • In collaboration with the transmission coordinator, ensures the execution of the programming instruction (PI) during live events in the event of failures, delays, or emergency changes.
  • Collects and organizes data related to commercial airings.

Requirements:

  • Fluent in both English/Portuguese, with excellent communication skills.
  • Previous experience in Traffic, Broadcast Scheduling, or Media Operations;
  • Familiarity with playout systems and scheduling tools;
  • High attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work under pressure;
  • Strong communication skills and team-oriented mindset;
  • Basic technical understanding of video formats and broadcast standards;
  • Proficiency in Excel and strong organizational skills for managing materials and reports;

—--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PT- BR

Descrição da Vaga – Rights Account Manager

Local: São Paulo (modelo híbrido)

Empresa: Nosso Futebol

Visão Geral da Função:

Como Analista de OPEC, você será responsável por garantir a execução adequada da grade de programação e dos espaços comerciais do canal, assegurando a correta inserção de conteúdos, chamadas e janelas publicitárias. Atuando de forma integrada com as áreas de programação, operações e comercial, o profissional será peça-chave para o controle técnico e operacional das exibições diárias.

Responsabilidades

  • Responsável pela conferência, organização e inserção de janelas comerciais no sistema de playout.
  • Garante o correto agendamento de conteúdos, chamadas e comerciais, respeitando as definições estabelecidas nas PIs.
  • Realiza o controle de materiais a serem exibidos, conferindo se estão disponíveis, com qualidade técnica e nomeação correta.
  • Garante o recebimento de CRTs e/ou outras documentações necessárias.
  • Realiza ajustes operacionais de última hora sob demanda da Coordenação de Programação.
  • Em conjunto com o coordenador de transmissões, no caso de partidas ao vivo, garanta a execução da PI em caso de falhas, atrasos ou mudanças emergenciais.
  • Coleta e organiza dados de exibições comerciais.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em OPEC, programação de TV ou operações de mídia;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de playout e ferramentas de agendamento de mídia;
  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso de responsabilidade e capacidade de trabalho sob pressão;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe;
  • Conhecimento técnico básico de formatos e padrões de vídeo;
  • Domínio de Excel e boa organização para controle de materiais e relatórios
  • Ingles avançado / fluente

  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:​

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!​

Nosso Jeito:​

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.​

Valores e Propósito:​

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos​.

Diversidade e inclusão:​

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.​

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”)..
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.

title: Management Trainee Program
description:
About the job

Come Join our Family Today!

Together, We Make Travel Better!

What you'll be doing:

This 18-month Global Management Trainee Program at Plaza Premium Group is designed to develop the next generation of supervisory leaders in the global traveler hospitality industry with a specialized development track: Operational Management Trainee. Trainees gain hands-on experience by rotating through different departments, across different cities or countries, from behind-the-scenes roles to customer-facing positions in operations, guest services, and more.

This 360-degree view of the business gives trainees a deep understanding of how the company works under the influence of PPG's culture. In addition to the on-the-job training, trainees also contribute to the company's global projects. This helps them build critical skills such as project management, budgeting, and collaborating across teams. The goal is to equip them with the leadership abilities and global mindset needed to take on supervisory responsibilities within Plaza Premium Group's worldwide network of over 5,800 employees in 30+ countries.

  • On-boarding Training: Undergo a comprehensive on-boarding process to familiarize yourself with the company's history, culture, policies, and procedures. Participate in training sessions and workshops to develop a strong foundation in the traveler hospitality industry and the Plaza Premium Group's operations.
  • National/International Rounded Work Experience: Participate in a structured rotation through various departments including supporting departments, revenue-driven operations to gain a broader understanding of our company with hands-on experience.
  • Client facing and revenue-driven departments such as Customer Service, Lounge Operations, Food & Beverage, Hotels and Guest Relations to experience the core of our business.
  • Participate Global Projects: You are invited to participate our new exciting global projects at various locations. To learn how business ideas come to live with project management, budgeting concepts and collaboration with cross-functional teams to unlock challenges and deliver results.
  • Personal Development Training: Continue to develop yourself around your professional-self, ranging from various forms of self-development training workshops, management skills workshops, soft-skills development, project-based task force assignment and mentorship with experienced leaders within the organization.
  • Performance Evaluation: Engage in regular feedback and performance evaluations to track your progress and refine your career path within Plaza Premium Group.

About you:

The ideal candidate should meet the following criteria:

  • University graduates (within the last 2 years) in any discipline related to hospitality, aspiring to travel and work to gain global exposure.
  • Excellent customer service orientation and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English and an additional language will be a plus.
  • Open-minded and adaptable to changing environments.
  • Flexibility to work in different regions for extended periods.

title: Coordenador de laboratório
description:
Sobre nós

A Archroma é uma empresa líder e reconhecida globalmente em produtos químicos especiais, dedicada a criar um mundo mais colorido, sustentável e eficiente. Nossa missão é ser a melhor parceira para nossos clientes, com um profundo comprometimento com inovação, qualidade e sustentabilidade.
