Estamos em busca de um líder talentoso e dinâmico, com sólidas habilidades consultivas comerciais e experiência, para se juntar à nossa equipe regional de Desenvolvimento de Negócios, como líder da equipe de Pré-vendas. Esta é uma posição chave para atingir o plano de crescimento regional da empresa.
Responsabilidades:
Desenhar, implementar e acompanhar estratégias de prospecção de clientes B2B no território designado.
Acompanhar os níveis de eficácia dos contatos com clientes prospectados através de ligações telefônicas, estratégias de envio de e-mails, correspondências comerciais, mensagens de texto, encontros presenciais e redes sociais, para verificar a efetividade da gestão da equipe ao agendar o maior número de reuniões efetivas.

Experiências com liderança de equipes de vendas/pré vendas;

Desejável experiências no setor educacional B2B;

title: Trade Finance Professionals
description:
About the Role:
Euro Exim Bank, an award-winning global financial institution is seeking freelance-based professionals who are truly Passionate About Sales. Your main task is to attract new clients involved in international trade such as exporters and importers by offering them our trade finance services such as Letters of Credit, Standby Letters of Credit and Bank Guarantees necessary for them to trade successfully in the global market.
Freelance basis only (this is NOT a permanent position)

Working from home from your country of residence (this is NOT an office-based position)

Brazil.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About the job
Why join Safeguard Global?
We want to help you
“Work in Any Way ” - that makes time for family, commitments, and life outside, so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work.
The role in a nutshell :
As a Salesforce Developer, you will design, build, and maintain custom solutions on the Salesforce platform, leveraging tools like Flows, Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Components. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, integrate Salesforce with external systems, and ensure high-quality development through testing and best practices.
How you will make a difference:
Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions on the Salesforce platform using Flows, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), related applications and other Salesforce technologies.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, admins, architects and project managers to gather and understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Customize and configure Salesforce to meet business needs, including creating custom objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, process automation, reports and dashboards.
Integrate Salesforce with other systems using REST, SOAP, and other APIs.
Participate in refining user stories, code reviews, perform unit testing, integration and functional testing; and follow best practices for development and deployment.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Salesforce implementations and integrations.
Keep up to date with Salesforce releases, new features, and best practices to continuously improve the platform.
Provide technical guidance and support to other team members and departments as needed.
Document technical solutions, processes, and development work for future reference.
What will give you an advantage:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development and administration.
Experience in Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) process, coding standards, change control, and version management
Proficient in Flows, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura and LWC), SOQL, and SOSL.
Experience with Salesforce configuration, including flows, validation rules, and process automation; and integration tools and techniques, including REST and SOAP APIs.
Strong understanding of Salesforce security, including roles, profiles, and sharing rules.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language.
Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or II, Salesforce Certified Administrator) are a plus
Who we are and what we do:
Safeguard Global is....Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.
Our Global Benefits
Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Be supported with as much flexibility as possible.
Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.
2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.
Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.
Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
Why become a Guardian:
International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.
Welcome to the Future of Work!
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.
We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!
RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.
  • Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.
  • Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

  • Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.
  • Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.

  • At least 4 years of professional software development experience.
  • Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.
  • Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.
  • Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).
  • Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.
  • Strong working knowledge of relational databases.
  • Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.
  • A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.
  • An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.
  • Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.
  • Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.
    NICE TO HAVE
  • Kubernetes or EKS.
  • Algolia.
  • Shopify.
  • DynamoDB

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

is
the

Collaborate with the team on software architecture, design, and implementation

Begin to mentor and share knowledge with less experienced team members

1-3 years of relevant experience in full-stack software development
Proficiency in Go or C#, AWS, React, and Typescript/JS · Proficiency with SQL, NoSQL, or graph database technologies
Good understanding of software architecture, design principles, and best practices
Growing independence in task execution with occasional need for guidance
Effective team collaboration and communication skills
Be fully aligned to the our core values:
o Think Big
- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
o Be Curious
- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
o Take Action
- Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
o Stronger Together
- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust
that you are good at what you’re doing. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation . Hierarchies are not our thing and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen and ideas valued.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

The Implementation Manager, working with the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Manager, plays a crucial role in executing the Client's Skillsbuild program through strategic partnerships across a specified geography. This individual will be responsible for managing all aspects of program implementation, ensuring high-quality delivery, and achieving key performance indicators (KPIs) including but not limited to learner engagement, course completions, and credentials issued.

Program Implementation & Management:
Oversee the rollout of the program through partner organizations to drive pre-determined learner outcomes.

Performance Monitoring:
Track and analyze program performance against KPIs, including learner engagement rates, course completion rates, and the issuance of credentials. Implement strategies to address any gaps or areas for improvement.
Internal Management Processes:
Managing and coordinating across CSR sub-teams to ensure internal stakeholders are aligned/consulted/informed, as per RACI matrix.
Quality Assurance:
Work closely with the content and credentialing teams to ensure that all program offerings implemented by the partners meet our high standards for content quality and credentialing criteria.
Feedback Loop:
Collect and synthesize feedback from partners and participants to inform continuous improvement of the program.
Reporting:
Prepare and present regular reports on program status, challenges, and achievements to senior management and relevant stakeholders to ensure targets are being achieved.

Program Management : Self-organized with a keen ability to identify problems and
develop solutions to complex challenges; be able to manage multiple
workstreams and priorities at once, be able to synthesize and distil information
from multiple inputs to develop a strong strategy & plan; must be willing to take
on strategic challenges and deliver solutions.
Learning : A sound knowledge of instructional design, program development, analytics, learning technology and learning principles.
General understanding of the educational and workforce skills landscape with a sound knowledge of new technology fields : Such as AI, Cyber, Data, Cloud, Software Development and key employability skills for entry level employment in these fields.
Relationship with partner organizations : Strong professionalism and stakeholder management skills and experience of working with organizations such as educational establishments, non-profit enterprises, government agencies (especially those focused on employment and upskilling) and training providers.

·
Minimum 8 years’ experience in program management / consulting and/or digital learning transformation roles
Experience with digital (online) learning platforms and digital credentials
Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
Strategic thinking & project management expertise
Strong work ethic with a competitive nature and a desire to succeed
Intense curiosity to learn and willingness to be coached
Experience in CSR or with an NPO/NGO, especially with a focus on workforce development
Can easily adapt to different environments and cultures. Customer / partner relationship skills
Drive, self-motivation and robust organisational skills are important as the role involves working from home (or the office when needed) as part of a large virtual team
This job will help the individuals to develop 1. Partner success management
experience 2. Program management experience 3. Stakeholder relationship
management experience 4. Leadership experience 5. Expertise on skills
development 6. Managing digital transformations

You have a strategic mind. You work well in an innovative and entrepreneurial environment and help paint the landscape of future IBM engagements with the global community.
You are passionate and believe corporations bring high value to society. You can't wait to talk about what IBM is doing to change the world and how others can join this effort.

You’re a fast learner and agile, assimilating information quickly to turn it

description:

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in

and
energy transmission projects
across global markets.
We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. Key Responsibilities:
Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)

Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
Minimum 4+ years of experience
in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus
Bonus:
Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
Understanding of ESG practices in engineering
Why Join Us:
Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
Get involved in international projects with real impact
Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture
Who is Xelvin?
Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.
Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!
As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.
What do we offer?
Contract wise:
· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).
· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)
· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.
· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.
· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.
· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.
· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)
Onboarding & benefits:
· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.
· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.
· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.
· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.
· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.
· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;
o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.
o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Médico Psiquiatra
description:
*
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA NA TELADOC HEALTH"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas/Médicos Especialistas, ou Residentes em
Psiquiatria , ou que já tenham concluído a formação. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
*
Estamos na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável, através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento clínico em diversas áreas, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
A/O profissional será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades: Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em
Psiquiatria , ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES:
Realizar atendimento clínico (generalista) por vídeo e telefone com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários;
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em psiquiatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com transtornos mentais.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações psíquicas à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em psiquiatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar transtornos mentais.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde mental.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
Formação Acadêmica (será submetido a comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PSIQUIATRIA, COMPLETO, OU EM ANDAMENTO
Certificações (serão solicitadas no processo seletivo, como carater eliminatório):
Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Psiquiatria, modelo oficial (Certidão de RQE/Certificado de Registro de Especialidade, pelo CRM responsável);
Matrícula do último semestre, em Instituição de Ensino aprovada, em Especialização, Residência, ou Pós-Graduação;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).
Experiência:
Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Psiquiatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Outros Requisitos Importantes:
Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.
Local de Trabalho:
REMOTO
REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS
Inglês (Intermediário/fluente);
Espanhol (Intermediário/fluente;
Especializações clínicas que complementem o atendimento psicoterapêutico.
MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:
PJ (necessário ter CNPJ)

title: Medical Information Specialist
description:
The Multilingual Medical Information Specialist (MIS) position is part of the ProPharma Medical Information Contact Center and follows all corresponding regulations, industry standards, and client/internal policies regarding medical information and the collection and documentation of adverse events, special situation events, and product complaints.
Essential Functions Include:

  • Responds to unsolicited consumer, health care professional and other external customer requests for medical and safety information received via telephone, website/e-mail, letter, fax, and scientific meetings on behalf of ProPharma’ s pharmaceutical clients.
  • Provides labeled and unlabeled medical/safety information responses in accordance with regulatory requirements, industry standards and client and ProPharma internal policies and practices.
  • Accurately identifies, documents and reports adverse events, pregnancy reports, special situation events and product complaints in a clear and concise manner per government regulations, ProPharma Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client Working Practices (WPs).
  • Ensures tasks are completed within the deadlines documented in the agreed ProPharma SOPs and WPs.
  • Formulates and provides accurate responses utilizing approved labeling and company standard responses, published literature and other data. Assists with writing custom medical information responses utilizing this data.
  • Logging all enquiries handled in an accurate, comprehensive, and timely fashion into Inquiry Handling Systems. Quality Assurance
  • Maintains quality in all areas of the job, including performing quality checks on Adverse Events, Product Quality Complaints, correspondence, and enquiries logged into the Inquiry Handling Systems General
  • Provides after-hours coverage on a rotated basis subject to business requirements.
  • Adheres to company and country-specific privacy policies, ensuring any confidential information or personal data related to ProPharma and its clients is managed in accordance with Data Privacy regulations described in ProPharma SOPs and the Confidentiality Statement within the Contract of Employment.
  • Complies with the Company’s health and safety policies.
  • Other activities as assigned as delegated by the Manager.
    Qualified candidates must have:
  • Nursing degree (RN/BS/BA/MS) MANDATORY
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proofreading, professional telephone etiquette and empathetic customer service skills.
  • Ability to write in a fluent and grammatically correct manner in the target language for the role
  • Mother tongue in Brazilian Portuguese, fluent in English.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, regulations and industry standards.
  • Strong cognitive abilities, including verbal reasoning, critical thinking and analytical ability.
  • Ability to multitask with attention to detail within restrictive timeframes, including sound planning, prioritizing and organizational skills.
  • Proactive with demonstrative ability to independently identify problems and suggest effective solutions.
  • Ability to learn, take instruction and apply to daily operations/tasks.
  • Receptive to constructive feedback and able to take responsibility for work allocated.
  • Self-motivating. Ability to demonstrate initiative and internal drive. Willingness to seek out additional workload projects.
  • Effectively work independently and as part of a team.
  • Highly proficient in computer applications, including Microsoft Office software platforms and Adobe Acrobat, and experience using a document management system. Aptitude to learn other computer systems including inquiry handling database.

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.
Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!
Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!
Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de dados para se juntar à nossa equipe.
Sobre a posição
Buscamos um Engenheiro de dados Sênior com sólida experiência em Python para liderar o desenvolvimento e implementação de um Master Data Management (MDM) de Pacientes. O profissional irá trabalhar na modelagem de dados, especificação de regras de negócios e implementação dessas regras e tabelas no ambiente Databricks, unificando dados de pacientes provenientes de múltiplos sistemas de origem.
Responsabilidades
· Desenvolver e implementar a arquitetura de modelagem de dados do MDM de Pacientes
· Especificar e documentar regras de negócios para unificação e tratamento de dados de pacientes
· Implementar pipelines de processamento de dados no Databricks
· Desenvolver lógicas para matching, deduplicate e golden record de pacientes
· Estabelecer fluxos de qualidade de dados e validação
· Criar e manter tabelas integradas seguindo as regras de negócios estabelecidas
· Implementar rotinas de atualização e sincronização de dados
· Participar de code reviews e mentoria técnica da equipe
· Colaborar com stakeholders de negócios para refinar regras e requisitos
Requisitos Técnicos
Essenciais
· Experiência avançada com Python
· Sólidos conhecimentos em:
Databricks e Delta Lake
PySpark para processamento de dados em larga escala
SQL e modelagem de dados
ETL/ELT e pipelines de dados
· Experiência com Master Data Management (MDM) ou projetos similares de integração de dados
· Conhecimento em técnicas de matching, fuzzy matching e deduplicação de registros
· Experiência com implementação de regras de negócios complexas em código
· Domínio de versionamento Git e metodologias ágeis
· Experiência com boas práticas de desenvolvimento (testes unitários, documentação)
Diferenciais
· Experiência prévia com MDM na área de saúde
· Conhecimento em FHIR ou outros padrões de dados de saúde
· Experiência com Great Expectations para qualidade de dados
· Conhecimento em frameworks de governança de dados
· Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, Event Hubs)
· Familiaridade com ferramentas de CDC (Change Data Capture)
· Conhecimento em observabilidade (Databricks SQL Analytics, Grafana)
· Experiência com APIs RESTful para exposição de dados
Benefícios
Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;
‍ Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;
Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;
Mentoring;
Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;
Assistência Médica;
Assistência Odontológica;
Clube de viagens;
Convênio para Pet;
e muito mais...

title: PPC Specialist
description:
PPC and Meta Ads Strategist
Quick Overview
We are searching for a talented and creative individual to plan, create, and manage, successful digital marketing campaigns.
Who is Hite Digital
Hite Digital
is a Digital Marketing Agency that is hyper-focused on People 1st & Our Services 2nd. Our number one goal is to create a work environment that lifts people up, helps develop them, and creates an environment that empowers people to perform at their best.
By focusing on our people first, our goal is enabling our team to 100% focus on our clients and the services we provide them all geared towards helping small businesses scale across the US.
With this mindset,
Hite Digital
has found themselves managing over 1M in marketing funds per year in just 4 months bringing on at least 2 new team members each month.
What is the role of a Digital Marketing Engineer @Hite Digital?
We call this role the brains of what we do at Hite Digital because our client's success or failure will boil down to how you manage the accounts, from setting up a great foundation to optimizing properly.
This position will manage up to 40 clients across different marketing channels like Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, among others. These clients vary in industry and can be both local lead generation focused as well as eCommerce centric.
The Digital Marketing Engineer is the lead strategist of the different marketing campaigns set forth for our clients and as such will coordinate with Account Managers who manage relationships with clients to ensure all parties involved are aware of the account’s progress, challenges, and wins.
Key Responsibilities
Facilitates the client onboarding experience by understanding the client, their industry, and their marketing goals and combining that with market research to draft go-to-market campaign strategies.
Conducts keyword, audience, competitor, and audience research to develop and optimize regular marketing campaigns on channels like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads.
Develops ad copy content for different marketing campaigns and marketing channels and is capable of providing creative direction to designers who will aid in the development of marketing assets.
Is responsible for managing paid media budget without overspending but is proactive and strategic about suggesting when budgets should be increased, decreased, or shifted based on performance needs and client goals.
Identify CRO opportunities: provides suggestions on website or landing page content that may help drive campaign conversion rates, including suggestions for offers, promotions, and user experience enhancements.
Provides suggestions on product titles and descriptions where appropriate.
Communicates progress, challenges, and wins via regular updates, including monthly reports and client-facing calls where appropriate.
Collaborates with team members: coordinates with Account Managers, Web Designers, and Account Managers to provide the best client experience possible.
Ensure proper campaign performance and return on investment measurement by installing and maintaining tracking measurements through softwares like GA4, WhatConverts, Call Rail, among others.
Requirements
Fully Bilingual in Spanish & English
BS/MS degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field
3 years experience managing Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads as a minimum
Highly creative with experience in identifying target audiences and devising digital campaigns that engage, inform and motivate
Strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking
Strong communication skills
Managing analytical software like GA4, Microsoft Clarify

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Analyst (Remote, US Central Time Zone Hours)
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.
Key Responsibilities:
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
Expertise in SQL.
Experience working in an Azure environment.
Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Especialista em Inteligência Artificial - GenAI
description:
O QUE É SER UM MUTANT?
Quando você decide ser Mutant, você decide dar um passo diferente na sua vida e na sua carreira.
Ser Mutant é aceitar ser parte de um grupo com coragem para traçar novos caminhos e ambição para chegar mais longe a cada dia.
A gente não é a empresa da moda - nem faz questão de ser. Ao contrário, fazemos muito mais do que falamos. E preferimos fazer em grupo porque aqui é com todos e por todos.
Estamos sempre em busca de gente talentosa e apaixonada para crescer e evoluir com a gente. Se você acredita no seu talento e consegue mostrar isso na prática, venha ser um Mutant.
A gente te aguarda.
Buscamos profissionais com experiência sólida em
Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Machine Learning,
com domínio em
engenharia de software, cloud computing e ciência de dados,
para atuar em iniciativas de alto impacto e inovação dentro da Mutant.
Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos, aprender constantemente e compartilhar conhecimento com o time, esse lugar é para você.
Para uma das posições (nível sênior), buscamos também alguém com maturidade para atuar junto a lideranças da Mutant e com clientes, com pensamento estratégico, comunicação clara e postura de liderança natural.
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Desenvolver e implementar modelos de IA (ML e Generativa), com aplicações em áreas como marketing digital, personalização, automação e análise de ROI.
Integrar soluções de IA em plataformas existentes e participar da construção de arquiteturas de dados eficientes.
Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, produto e tecnologia para identificar oportunidades de uso de IA em todo o funil de negócio.
Aplicar pensamento científico: estruturar problemas, documentar soluções, comunicar com clareza técnica e até elaborar documentos no estilo "paper", quando fizer sentido.
Avaliar novas tecnologias e ferramentas emergentes em IA, propondo soluções que impulsionem inovação e impacto real para a Mutant.
Para o perfil sênior: contribuir com visão estratégica, influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto, e atuar como uma referência técnica dentro do time.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, ou áreas correlatas (experiência acadêmica é um diferencial).
Experiência comprovada com Machine Learning, NLP e IA Generativa.
Sólida base em engenharia de software e cloud (preferencialmente com experiência em arquiteturas escaláveis e integrações de dados).
Capacidade de comunicar ideias técnicas com clareza — tanto para especialistas quanto para stakeholders não técnicos.
Curiosidade, autonomia para aprender e disposição para ensinar.
Inglês intermediário ou avançado (mínimo B2).

O que você vai encontrar por aqui:
Flexibilidade nos seus horários;
Estrutura horizontal;
Dress code livre;

Oportunidades de crescimento cross brands;

Além disso, incluímos também alguns benefícios com o propósito Mutant:

  • Liberdade para ser quem você é. Incluir todos com o mesmo olhar está em nosso DNA. Aqui não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, credo ou cor! Somos todos Mutants!
  • Pessoas e experiências são o que nos movem. São a nossa essência e nosso propósito. Ações e programas voltados a clima, desenvolvimento e cultura;
  • Gerar valor para pessoas e negócios. Juntos, criamos produtos digitais que impulsionam os negócios.;
  • Fazer parte de um time sensacional, que joga junto, com uma cultura de colaboração, inovação e transformação. E o mais importante: que se diverte em toda a jornada;
  • Trabalhar e trocar conhecimentos diários. As melhores cabeças do mercado em um lugar que elas podem ser elas mesmas: é assim que entregamos soluções disruptivas;

title: Country Sales Manager
description:
About MedChemExpress
The headquarter of MedChemExpress is based in the USA, and we have branch offices and warehouses in Europe and China. We have been supplying our products to most of the renowned research institutes, laboratories, Bio-tech companies and pharmaceutical companies cross the world since 2008. MCE works together with our over 500+ partners globally to find novel and vibrant ways of enhancing the lives of human beings.
MedChemExpress offers a wide range of high-quality research chemicals and biochemicals including novel life-science reagents, reference compounds, APIs and natural compounds for laboratory and scientific use. We take pride in offering only the highest-grade products. Product identity, quality, purity and activity are assured by our robust quality control programs and procedures. We provide HNMR, LC-MS, HPLC, stability testing and activity assays of our products to clients.
Inhibitors & Agonists
50,000+ selective Inhibitors and Agonists targeting 1000 key proteins in 20+ signaling pathways. Applications in different disease areas.
Screening Libraries
MCE Compound Libraries consist of 20,000+ small molecules with validated biological and pharmacological activities. 200+ ready-to-use compound libraries. 20,000+ fragment compounds with the diversity of structures. Focus on various research areas and signaling pathways.
What we offer
We are committed to creating a harmonious, inclusive, and efficient workplace, so that every employee at the company has sufficient room to grow and maximize their potential. As a global company, we recruit staff from all over the world to boost workforce localization. With MedChemExpress, there are always opportunities to break new ground. We empower you to fulfill your ambitions, and our diverse businesses offer various career moves to seek new horizons. Welcome to join us and bring your curiosity to life!
Country Sales Manager
Full Job Description
MedChemExpress has an immediate opening for
Country Sales Manager
base in Brazil. This is a full time position with career advancement opportunities within the company. You must be available to work from Monday to Friday and willing to travel. You must be legally working in Brazil.
Location based: Brazil (Work from home)
MedChemExpress is a renowned globally company in the chemicals and biochemicals research market specializing in the development of novel life-science reagents, reference compounds, APIs and natural compounds, and MedChemExpress is rapidly expanding its sales team in Brazil to further develop more customers.
Your role

  • Ability to work independently to achieve sales growth and reach sales targets for the MedChemExpress product line in your sales area in Brazil.
  • Promote the MedChemExpress brand and products in the responsible sales area in Brazil.
  • Ability to interact well with customers and maintain good customer relationships, visit customers regularly, develop new customers, being professional and courteous.
  • Ability to professionally receive customer calls, chats, and emails regarding orders and technical questions.
  • Ability to communicate accurate information regarding products, prices, product availability, and current promotions to customers.
  • Ability to work as an effective team player to ensure the highest level of efficiency and success for the team.
  • Cooperate with the BD manager and marketing manager to participate in product branding and marketing events.
  • Ability to collect local market and industry information, do market research, and share with the team to help with marketing strategies and plans.
  • Excellent business communications skills (verbal, written, presentation), organizational skills, and computer skills.
  • Capacity to monitor and engage in relevant social discussions about our company, competitors, and/or industry, both from existing customers and leads for new audiences.
  • Accept customer inquiries and build customer files; follow up order processing and delivery; provide after-sale service.
  • Attend exhibitions, scientific conferences, and trade shows; develop marketing campaigns; collect customer information.
    Required Skills
  • Bachelor's degree or above in life science, Bioscience, Biology, Pharmacy, chemistry, drug chemistry, biochemistry and related disciplines.
    (Must)
  • Familiarity with biological or biomedical or biochemical or pharmaceutical industry, at least three year of relevant working experience.
  • Willing to engage in sales work; can withstand certain work pressure.
  • Friendly and talkative, open-minded, strong sense of responsibility.
  • Good communication skills, ambition, strong customer service awareness.
  • High level of self-motivation and perseverance.

7.Proficient in both spoken and written English and Brazilian. (Must)
What you will get in return

  • A full support from EU and Asian based team.
  • A comprehensive training package.
  • Basic salary plus sales commission.

title: Especialista de Automação, Controle e Sensoriamento
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar padrões técnicos para automação e sensoriamento, garantindo uniformidade e eficiência nos processos.
  • Revisar e aprovar projetos de automação das unidades operacionais, assegurando conformidade com diretrizes técnicas.
  • Programar e desenvolver lógicas de controle para CLPs Siemens e Schneider, incluindo a criação e revisão de diagramas elétricos.
  • Prestar suporte técnico e consultoria às unidades operacionais, auxiliando na implementação de soluções avançadas de automação.
  • Especificar sensores e instrumentos, garantindo a correta seleção e aplicação nos projetos.
  • Realizar treinamentos e workshops para equipes operacionais, promovendo a padronização e disseminação de boas práticas.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Experiência sólida com CLPs Siemens e/ou Schneider, incluindo programação e lógica de controle.
  • Conhecimento em redes de comunicação industrial e interpretação de diagramas elétricos.
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos de automação.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo presencial no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Advanced English

You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.
You deliver what you commit to.
After 3 months:
You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.
You help others by sharing knowledge, spotting problems early, and improving processes or tooling.
You make decisions with both the codebase and business goals in mind.

Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped)
Quality and reliability of your code.
Consistency in delivery.
Feedback from peers and leads.
Your ability to work independently and unblock others.

7+ years
experience in software development

C#
and the
.NET
ecosystem, including: NET Core, ASP.NET Core and .NET 6 or later
Strong proficiency with
Entity Framework Core
and
MS SQL Server
Solid understanding of
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), SOLID
principles.
Experience with to

description:

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

AppSec Specialist

Finally, you will seed the application security culture for the entire company.
Responsibilities:

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Read this first
We get 1,000+ applicants.
We only review submissions that complete this pre-interview form.
You MUST copy and paste this entire link into your browser ( doesn’t allow hyperlinks):
We read every single one. If you're serious about performance marketing and obsessed with CAC, you'll love this.
And now, autobrush.
autobrush is an ADA-accepted and clinically proven u-shaped toothbrush. It’s a brand built on innovation, disruption, and unmatched quality. We are obsessed with our customers, passionate about learning, and known for quick pivots in a fast-paced DTC environment. We are a self-funded, bootstrapped startup with high standards, and we expect the same from you.
autobrush is and will remain a fully remote company with a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and impact. We are equally obsessed with your experience as a part of this team.
About the Role
: autobrush is on a mission to revolutionize oral care, and we’re looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own, scale, and optimize our paid growth engine, with total clarity on CAC and contribution margin.
This isn’t just about managing campaigns. This is about owning CAC economics across Meta, Google, and beyond — by working across teams to guide creative strategy, funnel testing, and growth experimentation. You won’t be doing everything solo, but you will be the one making sure it all moves.
You are:
A senior media buyer who can confidently scale Meta accounts to $20k+/day
A creative strategist who knows that the hook makes or breaks the ROAS
A funnel hacker who understands how ads, landing pages, and offers stack together
A data junkie who gets attribution, contribution margin, and payback windows
A growth architect who sees paid social as just one lever in a much bigger machine
You will:
Scale paid media profitably (working closely with Cori and the growth team)
Launch banger creative (orchestrating freelancers, creators, and AI tools)
Build and iterate funnels that unlock higher AOV and LTV (partnering with our CRO team)
Treat CAC like it's your P&L (because you own the outcomes, not every execution)
You'll be the conductor of the growth machine — accountable for performance while leveraging our CRO team, creative partners, and AI tools to execute at scale.
This is a high-impact, high-accountability role. You’ll be expected to move fast, test fearlessly, and own the economics of paid acquisition.
What You’ll Need to Be Great Here
Deep Meta experience. You’ve scaled accounts to $20k+/day. You’re fluent in attribution realities and can build and optimize winning structures from scratch. Bonus: You’ve run Google/YT too.
Creative-first mindset. You know creative is the biggest growth unlock. You’ve written briefs, launched UGC, tested static vs. video, and can spot a hook that’ll scale.
Funnel building instincts. You’ve run listicles, VSLs, and whitelisting campaigns, and you understand how landing pages and offers work together to drive conversion and AOV.
CAC & LTV fluency. You don’t just track ROAS—you model CAC scenarios, contribution margin, payback periods, and downstream monetization. You live to lower CAC—or raise it, when the funnel and AOV justify it.
Data fluency. You can’t sleep if you don’t know your CTR, CPA2C, CVR, MER, and LTV/CAC. You know how to interpret data and use it to fuel the next round of creative and funnel testing.
Testing rigor. You care about statistical significance, know how to structure clean tests, and build dashboards that reflect true business performance—not just platform metrics.
Execution operator. You ship fast. You track what’s tested, document what’s working, and brief what’s next without needing to be told twice.
Team builder & orchestrator. You know when to execute and when to delegate. You’ve scoped, vetted, and managed freelancers, agencies, and contractors—ensuring quality and speed without compromise.
AI-powered operator. You use Claude, ChatGPT, Shopify Sidekick, Motion, or other tools to 10x your output. From creative briefs to performance insights and ad copy variations—you treat AI as a co-pilot, not a gimmick. Prompt engineering is baked into your workflow. If you're still doing everything manually in 2025, this isn’t the role for you.
Key Responsibilities
Paid Acquisition & Scaling
Own and scale our paid media channels (Meta first, YouTube/Google/TikTok/Pinterest next)
Optimize audience structures, placements, and budgets to hit CAC and LTV goals
Collaborate on offer testing that unlocks higher AOV and CAC flexibility
Work cross-functionally with CRO and design to align funnels, PDPs, landing pages, and upsells
Creative & Funnel Strategy
Source, vet, and manage specialized talent (creative strategists, video editors, UGC creators, landing page designers/devs) to scale execution without compromising quality
Build and manage a high-velocity creative testing pipeline
Lead hypothesis-driven testing across hooks, angles, formats, and messaging
Develop and test funnel variants (listicles, advertorials, quiz flows, direct-to-cart)
Use AI tools to generate creative variations, analyze competitor ads, and identify emerging trends
Build prompt libraries that turn AI into your personal growth assistant
Train AI on our brand voice to scale copy production without losing quality
CAC Reporting & Attribution Analysis
Build dashboards tracking CAC, MER, payback windows, and blended LTV
Model performance scenarios and make recommendations on spend and channel allocation
Analyze attribution data, cohort metrics, and survey insights to guide strategy
Present performance insights and creative learnings to leadership weekly
Leverage AI to analyze complex data sets and surface non-obvious optimization opportunities
Who You Are:
You think like a creative strategist and act like a performance operator. You’re as comfortable writing a hook test matrix as you are analyzing ad-level AOV. You thrive in high-growth chaos and crave ownership. You know that one great ad, one killer funnel, or one AOV-boosting bundle can unlock the next $1M in revenue.
You’ve scaled real DTC brands with real P&L pressure.
You own outcomes, not tasks. You know when to execute yourself and when to bring in the right freelancers, creators, or partners to get the job done fast and right.
Most of all: you treat CAC like your P&L.
Why This Role is Unique:
You’ll have autonomy and ownership over one of the most important levers in the company
You’ll work alongside a Head of Growth who’s world-class (and who you may one day replace)
You’ll scale a brand that’s changing the game in oral care and outcompeting funded giants
You’ll define and execute the playbook that lets autobrush outspend every competitor
You’ll be given room to test, learn, and move fast, without red tape
You’ll collaborate directly with creative, CRO, and media partners, but you’ll be the one connecting the dots and calling the plays.
What Makes Us Special
We care. We’re obsessed with our customers and the details that impact their experience
We take responsibility. We own our wins, mistakes, and everything in between
We solve problems. Challenges excite us—we find solutions, not excuses
We prioritize people. Relationships come first. We build trust, not just transactions
Why Join Us
Shape the growth engine of a disruptive, high-growth oral care brand
Work in a fast-paced DTC team where ideas turn into results—fast
Own a performance marketing role with real impact and real scale
Be part of a self-funded company that thinks and executes like a rocketship
Ready to apply?

title: Coordenador de laboratório
description:
Sobre nós
A Archroma é uma empresa líder e reconhecida globalmente em produtos químicos especiais, dedicada a criar um mundo mais colorido, sustentável e eficiente. Nossa missão é ser a melhor parceira para nossos clientes, com um profundo comprometimento com inovação, qualidade e sustentabilidade. Coordenar o suporte fornecido pela equipe do laboratório às áreas de vendas e técnica com o objetivo de manter e aumentar a participação de mercado dos nossos produtos;
Gerenciar e registrar todo o trabalho do laboratório, conduzindo-o em todas as etapas;

Responsável pela declaração e licenças do exército, polícia federal e polícia civil do laboratório;
Responsável pelo estoque de reagentes e materiais, controlando rotulagem e validade;
Controlar e distribuir amostras padrão de cor;
Alto conhecimento em medições espectrofotométricas e software de colorimetria para diversas aplicações têxteis;
Combinação de tonalidades (cor e branco) em vários artigos e processos têxteis (exaustão, contínuo e impressão);
Desenvolvimento de acabamentos com efeitos especiais em vários artigos e processos têxteis (exaustão e contínuo);
Teste de desempenho de tecidos de acordo com procedimentos específicos;
Preparar relatórios e também verificar relatórios de analistas para testes de análise realizados, a fim de manter registro de mudanças e/ou resultados arquivados;
Assegurar a conformidade dos aspectos legais de acordo com questões de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente;

Graduação completa em Química;
Desejável: Técnico em Química ou Têxtil;
Habilidade de Trabalho em Equipe;
Habilidades Organizacionais;
Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos;
Inglês intermediário para leitura de processos, escrever e-mails, traduzir métodos e informações técnicas, além de se comunicar com outros laboratórios;
Conhecimento desejável em SAP;
Capacidade de priorizar e lidar com várias tarefas;
Conhecimento de Word, Excel e Power Point;

title: Elastic Search Engineer
description:
About Lilo
Lilo is revolutionizing procurement for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) businesses by providing a single platform to automate and optimize procurement processes using AI. From hotels to gyms, schools, and senior living homes, we streamline workflows like invoicing, vendor management, and price comparisons—saving our clients both time and money. We are already transforming procurement for major brands like Fairfield, Hampton Inn, and Hilton.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly experienced
ElasticSearch Engineer
with a strong background in designing and optimizing search systems at scale, particularly within
eCommerce or marketplace environments . This is an ideal role for engineers who thrive on building performant, intelligent search experiences that power real-time decision-making. If you're passionate about semantic search, relevance tuning, and large-scale search infrastructure, we want to hear from you!
What You Will Do
Architect, implement, and optimize ElasticSearch solutions for our AI-driven procurement platform.
Design and maintain scalable search infrastructure to support complex querying across dynamic datasets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate search features into the product, including faceted search, autocomplete, and semantic search.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve search performance, accuracy, and latency.
Evaluate and implement natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and contextual understanding.
Stay ahead of advancements in search technology, particularly in vector search and semantic search models.
What You Will Need
3+ years of hands-on ElasticSearch experience, especially in production systems for
eCommerce or online marketplaces .
Strong understanding of search architecture, including indexing strategies, analyzers, tokenization, and ranking algorithms.
Experience integrating ElasticSearch into distributed systems at scale.
Solid programming experience with Python and/or JavaScript.
Proficiency with Docker and containerized deployments.
Experience with semantic search, NLP, or vector embeddings is a
strong plus .
English or Spanish proficiency at C1 or C2 level, both written and spoken.
Availability to work in US East Coast time zone.
Ownership mentality and strong problem-solving skills—comfortable driving features from design to production with minimal oversight.
Why Lilo?
Work remotely from LATAM with a fast-growing, US-based startup.
Have a direct impact on core product features and search infrastructure.
Stock options for the right candidate.
Join a collaborative, global, and multi-cultural team focused on building cutting-edge procurement tech.

description:

você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de
22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.
Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo a
uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos
de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,

Mentorias semanais
com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.

exclusiva
para acompanhamento das aulas.

Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.

Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?
Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .
Necessário:
Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta
não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?
Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?
Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Especialista DevOps
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec + Sinqia!
Diariamente, processamos bilhões de transações através dos nossos produtos, impactando diretamente a vida de muitos brasileiros. Estamos entre as 100 maiores Fintechs do mundo. Responsabilidades e atribuições
A área de
Arquitetura
é responsável por liderar a evolução tecnológica das plataformas, promovendo a modernização de sistemas legados, impulsionando iniciativas de automação, aprimorando o monitoramento e buscando eficiência operacional e busca um
Especialista DevOps
para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução.
Esse cargo é responsável por:
•Liderar projetos complexos de migração e modernização de infraestrutura, incluindo estratégias multicloud, híbridas e cloud-to-cloud. Projetar e evoluir plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (IDPs) utilizando soluções como Humanitec, Port, Backstage, Crossplane ou similares, com foco em abstração, segurança e experiência do desenvolvedor. Implantar e evoluir sistemas de score de maturidade de DevOps e Engenharia de Plataforma, com métricas orientadas a DORA, SRE e entrega contínua.
•Criar e manter infraestrutura como código altamente reutilizável e governável com Terraform e Terragrunt. Projetar e manter Composite Actions no GitHub Actions para padronizar pipelines de CI/CD. Garantir boas práticas de Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS), incluindo segurança, observabilidade, políticas de rede, RBAC e autoescalabilidade.
•Trabalhar com AWS, GCP e Azure, desenhando soluções aderentes às boas práticas de cada provedor. Colaborar com engenharia de segurança, SRE e time de produto para garantir a entrega segura e eficaz de soluções em escala. Contribuir para a construção e governança de ambientes cloud, pipelines e plataformas orientadas a self-service.
Requisitos e qualificações
Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:
•Superior Completo em TI ou áreas correlatas.
•Sólida experiência com engenharia de plataforma e plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (IDPs). Profundo domínio de Terraform e Terragrunt, com boas práticas de modularização e organização de workspaces. Experiência na criação e manutenção de Composite Actions e integração contínua via GitHub Actions.
•Conhecimento avançado em Kubernetes (gerenciamento de clusters produtivos, observabilidade, segurança, workloads críticos). Experiência prática em
AWS, GCP e Azure , incluindo serviços essenciais de computação, rede, identidade e segurança. Familiaridade com ferramentas como Humanitec, Port, Crossplane, Backstage ou equivalentes.
•Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry). Capacidade de desenhar e aplicar sistemas de score de maturidade DevOps, incluindo análise de métricas DORA.
Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial:
•Inglês avançado (comunicação com stakeholders e times globais).
•Certificações relevantes (ex: AWS DevOps Pro, Azure DevOps Expert, Google Cloud Architect).
•Conhecimento de ferramentas de segurança como Vault, OPA, Kyverno.
•Experiência com políticas organizacionais e compliance em ambientes de grande escala.
•Experiência em ambientes regulados (bancos, telecom, healthcare).
IMPORTANTE : Essa oportunidade é para atuação no modelo Remoto, com eventuais necessidades de reuniões presenciais na Av. Paulista/SP

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Join Smarter Contact: Transforming Real Estate Communications
About us:
Smarter Contact is the leading text and voice messaging SaaS platform for US real estate professionals. To sustain our rapid growth, we’re seeking an experienced Platform Engineer, to build and scale the internal tools, environments, and systems that keep our product and teams running smoothly.
We are a fast-paced, Agile environment, ideal for people who thrive in motion, not maintenance. We’re looking for highly collaborative candidates energized by building, scaling, and continuously improving.
About the role:
We’re looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to build and scale the internal tools, environments, and systems that keep our product and teams running smoothly. You’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and automation—designing solutions that boost productivity, streamline operations, and support rapid growth.
You’ll join our engineering team to architect internal systems, developer tools, and simulations for third-party integrations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, support, and backend teams to make sure our platform is reliable, scalable, and easy to build on.
If you’ve worked in slow-moving teams or highly-structured corporate settings, this pace might feel intense. But if you’re someone who tackles dynamic challenges, takes ownership fast, and learns from users - you’ll find your place here.
The people who do really well in this role are the ones who love understanding the
“ why ”
behind what they’re building. They don’t just write code, but they also heavily focus on how a feature ties into the user journey, how it impacts performance, and what happens next once it’s live. They don’t wait to be told what to do - so proactiveness is highly desired.
Ideal environment for those who love to ask questions, spot gaps, and bring ideas to the table.
Key Responsibilities:
Design and implement internal DevOps tools and automation systems
Develop and maintain configuration management systems for multiple environments
Create and maintain simulation environments for third-party integrations
Build and improve developer productivity tools and extensions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and address platform needs
Contribute to the architecture and design of internal tools and systems
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions
Create a layered permissions Admin Panel to automate common support requests
Create a reporting framework to query system data for financial and operational reports
Technical Requirements:
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and best practices
Proficient in TypeScript and modern JavaScript development
Experience building and maintaining Chrome extensions
Strong SQL knowledge and experience with database optimization
Experience with GraphQL API development and integration
Expertise in developing simulation/mock environments for third-party APIs
Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools
Experience with configuration management and environment variable handling
Familiarity with API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, WebHooks)
Qualifications:
7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in platform or tooling engineering
Proven track record of building internal developer tools and automation systems
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and CI/CD practices
Experience with communication APIs (e.g., Twilio)
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Nice to Have:
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies
Background in SaaS or cloud-native applications
Experience with monitoring and observability tools
Experience with CRM platform integrations, ideally Hubspot
We are looking for the BEST that want to be part of a fast growing company that is set to take off. If you meet ALL of the qualifications, we can't wait to hear from you.

Somos parte de um grupo integrado de energia com operações globais, que abrange desde a exploração e produção de hidrocarbonetos até transporte, refinaria e comercialização. Além disso, estamos presentes em negócios de biocombustíveis e infraestruturas essenciais. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.

Gerenciar ambientes de cloud computing (Azure) e Azure Stack, incluindo configuração, automação, backup, políticas e segurança;
Implementar e manter infraestrutura de rede corporativa, incluindo segmentos petrótécnicos, firewalls, roteadores, switches, VPNs e redes OT/IT;
Estabelecer, documentar e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, alinhadas com frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD;
Monitorar continuamente o ambiente de TI utilizando ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics;
Implementar e acompanhar KPIs e métricas de segurança, desempenho e conformidade de TI;
Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos para auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo com planos de ação e mitigação de riscos;
Conduzir avaliações de vulnerabilidade, análise de riscos e resposta a incidentes;
Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de tecnologia, segurança, compliance e auditoria.
Requisitos e qualificações
Superior completo nas áreas de TI em geral;
Desejável especialização na área de Cibersegurança;
Desejável inglês e espanhol;
Hands on e organização.
Conhecimentos técnicos
Experiência comprovada com Microsoft Azure e Azure Stack;
Sólido conhecimento em infraestrutura de redes (LAN/WAN, VLANs, firewalls, roteamento, VPNs);
Experiência com cibersegurança, gestão de riscos, mitigação de vulnerabilidades e resposta a incidentes;
Capacidade de documentar e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de TI e segurança;
Vivência com monitoramento de ambiente cloud e on-premises;
Conhecimento de reportes e controles para auditorias (internas, externas e regulatórias);
Habilidade na criação, acompanhamento e análise de KPIs e dashboards de TI e segurança;
Familiaridade com LGPD e outras legislações de proteção de dados.
Desejável conhecimento em infraestrutura de redes petrótécnicas ou ambientes de operações industriais (OT).
Desejável certificações: AZ-104, AZ-500, SC-200, CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer.
Desejável experiência com ambientes regulados (energia, petróleo e gás, saúde, financeiro).
Desejável vivência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) – Terraform, ARM, PowerShell.
